text:
leo_cs: Heads up — MeridianAI QBR prep. Renewal ~28 days out. Primary risk = unexpected embedding surge + a large nightly reindex job. Need a short action plan for spend controls and an enablement with the ML team.

tara_se: Onboarding update: core SDK integration complete. They route both embeddings and chat. Embeddings are ~80% of token usage. They've got a nightly full-reindex cron that started last week.

priya_eng: Confirmed — the reindex job kicks off at 02:00 UTC, multi-threaded, pulls full corpus and requests dense vectors for every doc. Didn't sandbox it first. That's the spike.

omar_finops: Current snapshot:
```
MTD tokens: 9,120,000
avg_cost_per_1k: $0.0020
MTD spend: $18.24
30d projection (no change): 27,360,000 tokens -> $54.72
If reindex repeats weekly, expected 30d tokens: ~45M -> ~$90
```
They also have an alert at 10M/mo which fired yesterday.

billing-bot: Alert: MeridianAI has exceeded threshold 10,000,000 tokens this billing period. Action suggestions: apply soft quota, schedule canary for heavy jobs, or recommend reserved commitment.

leo_cs: Immediate ask for QBR deck: 1) short spend timeline and three-case forecast 2) recommended guardrails (quotas/alerts) 3) a quick enablement playbook for embedding efficiency.

tara_se: For the enablement: we'll show batching, prefix caching, and where to run the reindex (low-priority/discounted pool). Also demonstrate dedup + incremental reindex to avoid full scans.

priya_eng: Quick mitigation I can do now: throttle the cron to 5 parallel workers and add a dry-run flag for a subset of docs. Example change I pushed to their repo:
```
CRON=0 2 * * * /opt/reindex.sh --batch-size=256 --workers=5 --sample=0.1
```
That should cut token usage by ~8x for tonight.

omar_finops: For QBR I will prepare conservative/expected/aggressive spend projections and include a recommendation: set soft quota at 20M/mo, hard quota at 25M/mo, and propose a 6-month reserved commit if they want predictable unit pricing.

leo_cs: Owners and deadlines:
- tara_se: 30-min enablement demo + embed best-practice notes (ETA: 48h)
- priya_eng: implement cron throttle + sample run and post results (ETA: tonight)
- omar_finops: 3-scenario forecast + renewal risk note (ETA: EOD)
- leo_cs: compile QBR section + outreach to customer for pre-QBR checklist (ETA: 24h)

billing-bot: Suggested alert thresholds updated: soft=20,000,000 monthly, paging threshold=24,000,000. Use /alerts set to apply.

priya_eng: Ran the sample reindex (10% sample) — tonight's tokens dropped from estimated 6.2M to 560k in the sample extrapolation. I'll post logs and a short table in the shared drive.

tara_se: One note for the deck: show quality vs cost tradeoffs. We recommend trying 8-bit quant embeddings in canary and measuring recall loss on the 500-qps ranking set. If recall <2% drop, recommend rollout.

omar_finops: I'll also include a payment option: commit to 50M tokens/6mo which would reduce unit price to $0.0014/1k and remove overage unpredictability.

leo_cs: Any blockers?

priya_eng: Blocker: need access to their staging metrics dashboard to validate realtime cost change from the throttle. Meridian admin pls confirm access.

meridian-admin (via DM to leo_cs): Confirmed — adding staging_read access for @priya_eng. Also willing to schedule a 30-min pre-QBR on Friday.

leo_cs: Great. I'll draft the renewal health paragraph noting: "High spend volatility driven by un-sandboxed reindex jobs; mitigation in flight. Recommend soft quota + reserved commit conversation to reduce renewal friction."

tara_se: Ack. I'll build the demo slides and include a short checklist for engineers: sample size testing, canary rollout, monitoring KPIs (tokens/min, 99th latency, recall@10).

omar_finops: Ack. I'll attach the forecast CSV to the QBR folder once ready.

leo_cs: Thanks team — pinning for QBR prep. Will follow up after priya posts the sample run. :thumbsup:
